name: Create accepts 63 aggregate bytes
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template create extern_inst/externSizes/Register/case1 tc_numel 1 instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param v1 ptype bit64 id 2 default_value 1 param v2 ptype bit64 id 3 default_value 1 param v3 ptype bit64 id 4 default_value 1 param v4 ptype bit64 id 5 default_value 1 param v5 ptype bit64 id 6 default_value 1 param v6 ptype bit64 id 7 default_value 1 param v7 ptype bit64 id 8 default_value 1 param tail ptype bit24 id 9 default_value 1
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/externSizes/Register/case1 >/tmp/p4tc-size-$TESTID.json; python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; value=json.load(sys.stdin); items=[(p["name"],p["id"],p["value"]) for o in value for p in o["control_params"] if p["name"]!="index"]; assert sorted(items)==[('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'tail'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 9, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v1'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 2, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v2'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 3, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v3'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 4, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v4'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 5, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v5'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 6, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v6'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 7, 1), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'v7'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 8, 1)], (items,value)'"'"' </tmp/p4tc-size-$TESTID.json; $TC p4template del extern_inst/externSizes/Register/case1; printf bounded'
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/externSizes 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf "%s\n" "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
